source.title: Functions with minimal critical set: New results and open problems

trace.notes: Normalized the original input as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL with document identifier 1424240.

failure_mode=metadata_only plus network_or_dns_failure. Local zbMATH shard metadata identified the exact source as Dorin Andrica, 'Functions with minimal critical set: New results and open problems', 1999. Direct shell fetching of zbmath.org and api.zbmath.org was unavailable because outbound DNS is blocked in the CLI sandbox, and browser/page-reader access to the resolver did not expose a readable full-text artifact.

failure_mode=metadata_only after bounded recovery. Attempted identifiers and queries included zbMATH id 1424240, the exact title, exact-title plus PDF, exact-title plus author, and exact-title plus conference/proceedings searches. Rejected candidates because Dorin Andrica author pages, Goodreads/Hadronic book pages, and UTD seminar pages are citation, catalog, or event metadata only; Heidelberg/ResearchGate results for 'Functions with minimal number of critical points' are a different dissertation/work; ele-math, CiteSeer, and related PDF hits only cite the target work in references and do not contain the target problem statements.
evidence_refs: "Functions with minimal critical set: New results and open problems"

trace.notes: No open questions were accepted because no readable exact-work PDF or HTML source containing the technical problem statements was recovered. The workflow did not extract from citation metadata, catalog descriptions, search snippets, author bibliographies, or references in other papers.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/1424240.json and outputs/latest.json.
